recipe.title: Smoky kale crisps with pumpkin seeds
recipe.intro: Kale turns sweeter after the first frosts, so early December is when it shines. Baked low and slow, it becomes crisps the children will actually reach for.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.prep: stalks stripped out, leaves torn into large pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 140C fan, 160C conventional.
Wash the torn kale, then dry it really well in a clean tea towel. Any water left on the leaves will make them steam rather than crisp.
Put the kale in a large bowl, add the oil and rub it into every leaf with your hands. Sprinkle over the smoked paprika and salt and toss again.
Spread the kale over two roasting trays in a single layer, without piling it up. Scatter the pumpkin seeds among the leaves.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, swapping the trays halfway, until the leaves are crisp and dark green but not brown at the edges.
Grate the cheese over the hot crisps and leave them on the trays for 5 minutes, where they will crisp up a little more. Eat warm or cool.
recipe.tip: Keep any leftovers in an airtight tin for a day, and if they soften, give them 3 minutes back in the oven.
